name: Coyote
description: Amplitude-tracking onset detector for percussive material. Returns a trigger pulse when the input's tracked amplitude exceeds a threshold, with separate slow/fast envelope followers and a minimum duration to avoid double-triggering. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal whose amplitude is tracked

inputs.name: trackFall
inputs.description: Fall time of the amplitude tracker in seconds

inputs.name: slowLag
inputs.description: Smoothing time of the slow envelope follower in seconds

inputs.name: fastLag
inputs.description: Smoothing time of the fast envelope follower in seconds

inputs.name: fastMul
inputs.description: Multiplier applied to the fast envelope when comparing against the slow envelope

inputs.name: thresh
inputs.description: Minimum amplitude required to fire a trigger

inputs.name: minDur
inputs.description: Minimum time between triggers in seconds (prevents double-triggering)

name: TrigAvg
description: Triggered averaging accumulator. Computes the running mean of the input between successive triggers — useful for measuring per-grain or per-event statistics from a control stream. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal to average

inputs.name: trig
inputs.description: Trigger signal — non-positive to positive transitions reset the average and emit the previous window's mean

name: WAmp
description: Window-based amplitude follower. Computes the average absolute value of the input over a sliding window of fixed duration — gives a smoother and less peaky envelope than a one-pole follower. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal whose amplitude is tracked

inputs.name: winSize
inputs.description: Sliding window length in seconds

name: MarkovSynth
description: Markov-chain audio resynthesis. While isRecording is non-zero, learns a first-order transition table over the input's amplitude trajectory; once switched off, generates new audio by walking the learned chain. Produces glitchy, granular variations on the source material. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: in
inputs.description: Input signal to learn from while recording

inputs.name: isRecording
inputs.description: Non-zero to keep learning transitions; zero to freeze the table and synthesize from it

inputs.name: waitTime
inputs.description: Time spent at each Markov state before transitioning, in seconds

inputs.name: tableSize
inputs.description: Number of discrete states in the transition table — higher values track the source more faithfully

name: FrameCompare
description: FFT-frame difference metric. Compares two frequency-domain buffers (FFT outputs) and returns a scalar similarity measure weighted by wAmount. Useful for spectral matching, novelty detection or audio thumbnailing. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: buffer1
inputs.description: First FFT buffer to compare

inputs.name: buffer2
inputs.description: Second FFT buffer to compare

inputs.name: wAmount
inputs.description: Weighting amount applied to the magnitude/phase comparison (0 to 1)

name: NeedleRect
description: Scanline reader over a virtual image rectangle — sweeps a 'needle' across the rectangular region at a fixed rate, emitting normalised X/Y coordinates as audio-rate streams. Originally designed for image-driven sonification. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Scanning rate — frames per second over the rectangle

inputs.name: imgWidth
inputs.description: Total image width in pixels

inputs.name: imgHeight
inputs.description: Total image height in pixels

inputs.name: rectX
inputs.description: X origin of the scan rectangle in pixels

inputs.name: rectY
inputs.description: Y origin of the scan rectangle in pixels

inputs.name: rectW
inputs.description: Width of the scan rectangle in pixels

inputs.name: rectH
inputs.description: Height of the scan rectangle in pixels

name: SkipNeedle
description: Random index generator that 'skips' through a numeric range at a configurable rate — useful for driving BufRd phase as a glitchy random scrubber. By Batuhan Bozkurt. From sc3-plugins BatUGens.

inputs.name: range
inputs.description: Upper bound of the integer range scanned (exclusive)

inputs.name: rate
inputs.description: Number of skips per second

inputs.name: offset
inputs.description: Lower bound added to each emitted index
